AC-1: Given a report viewer has permission, when the progress view loads, then the summary and detail regions are visible.
AC-2: Given a report viewer lacks permission, when the progress route is requested, then access is denied without revealing report data.
AC-3: Given progress data is available, when a bounded date range is selected, then every metric uses the same inclusive range.
AC-4: Given a report contains multiple statuses, when a status filter changes, then summary charts and detail rows use the selected status.
AC-5: Given learner records are available, when a case-insensitive search is submitted, then matching rows are shown in stable order.
AC-6: Given no records match the active filters, when the report refreshes, then an actionable empty state replaces charts and rows.
AC-7: Given a report request is pending, when the view renders, then a labeled loading state prevents stale values from being presented.
AC-8: Given a report request fails, when the error response is received, then a bounded retry action is shown without exposing internals.
AC-9: Given summary values are returned, when the dashboard renders, then counts and percentages use deterministic numeric formatting.
AC-10: Given time-series points share a timestamp, when the trend chart is sorted, then points use ascending time and stable tie-breaking.
AC-11: Given distribution buckets are configured, when scores are grouped, then each valid score appears in exactly one bucket.
AC-12: Given detail rows exceed one page, when the next page is requested, then page size and active filters remain unchanged.
AC-13: Given two detail rows share the sort key, when sorting is applied, then the stable secondary key produces deterministic order.
AC-14: Given a keyboard user enters the report, when focus moves through controls, then focus order follows the visible workflow.
AC-15: Given a chart communicates status by color, when the chart renders, then text labels expose the same status meaning.
AC-16: Given a narrow viewport is used, when the report layout adapts, then controls and data remain reachable without overlap.
AC-17: Given a filter value is invalid, when the report request is prepared, then validation fails before any transport boundary.
AC-18: Given a retry succeeds after a transient failure, when fresh data is accepted, then the prior error state is cleared exactly once.
AC-19: Given the report view is closed, when temporary client state is released, then no credential or private report value is persisted.
